messages:
Marco: Heads-up — Samira Diaz starts today in the NYC office! Desk near the window (3rd floor). Could folks who want to join for a quick welcome lunch meet at 12:15 in the lobby? Also she needs a spare USB-C and a sticker for her laptop. @Samira Diaz feel free to drop your snack prefs :)

Samira Diaz: Hi everyone! Super excited to join Redwood Inference 🎉 I'm Sam (she/her), joining Product. I love grilled cheese, boba, and have a tiny succulent collection. I'll be on a scooter — might be ~5–10m late (traffic). Happy to meet!

Aj: Welcome @Samira 🎉 I'll grab a vegan option. Also pinging facilities — @Mona (People Ops) do we have an extra laptop sticker pack?

Mona (People Ops): @Aj yes we do. @Samira I'll meet you at the security desk at 11:50 to get your badge and access. Bring your ID. For desk setup: badge scanner is by Gate B (left of elevators). If you need a keyboard/USB-C cable, reply here and we'll drop it by.

hr-bot: Onboarding checklist (automated): 1) Badge pickup 2) Slack & email access 3) Payroll form 4) 1:1 with manager — items auto-checked within 24h after completion.

Oliver: Welcome Sam! There's a little grilled-cheese cart two blocks away that's 👌. I'll bring a spare USB-C cable just in case.

Tasha: @Samira FYI rooftop crew usually meets if it's sunny — i'll save you a seat. :sunny: Also we'll do a mini tour after lunch.

Samira Diaz: Thanks y'all — can't wait to meet everyone! I'll bring brownies (gluten-free option too). See you at 11:50 by security. :)
